result.summary: Re-checked commit 614fc82f (git diff 614fc82f~1..614fc82f) against version.ex's new @required_fields, entry.ex's publish_changeset/2, and design doc §4's service_catalog_versions column table. (1) Parity confirmed structurally, not just by comment claim: design §4's not-null column list for service_catalog_versions is exactly version_id/service_id/version/endpoint_url/required_auth/timeout_ms/published_at/retired_at -- verbatim what @required_fields now lists -- and the three excluded fields (request_schema/response_schema/retry_policy) are the same three the design doc marks nullable and that Entry's own publish_changeset/2 also leaves out of its required list. retired_at's inclusion (absent from Entry's own required list, since Entry's retired_at is null while ACTIVE) is correct for Version specifically: traced archive_changeset/1's only call site (ServiceCatalog.archive_current_version/1) and confirmed attrs always sets retired_at: now unconditionally -- never nil at insert, so requiring it introduces no reachable failure. (2) Scope: diff touches only version.ex (new list + one-line validate_required swap), the migration (removes the chk_service_catalog_version_length CHECK in both up/0 and down/0, provably dead since version is Ecto's default :string/varchar(255) already enforced at the Postgres column-type level before any CHECK could fire -- nothing in the design or requirement calls for version to exceed 255 chars), plus two test files mix format touched (whitespace-only, confirmed no assertion/behavior changes in the diff) and the step-03a handoff JSON. No unrelated modules, no new abstractions -- narrow. (3) Idiom: cast/3 + validate_required/2 restricted to true NOT NULL columns is correct, unremarkable Ecto usage; no schema/behaviour/macro introduced. mix compile --warnings-as-errors ran clean.
